run_update_metadata: run the update_metadata script to sync diffusers pipeline metadata to the huggingface hub
run_update_metadata_with_commit: run the update_metadata script with a specific commit SHA to track the diffusers version

refactor_get_supported_pipeline_table: refactor get_supported_pipeline_table to add support for additional auto pipeline mappings
